component.name: MultiChat
component.summary: Twitch, Kick and YouTube chat in one window

description.p: MultiChat combines the live chats of Twitch, Kick and YouTube in one window – with video tiles to watch the streams, emotes (including 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ), platform filters, sending and moderating after logging in, and an overlay for OBS.

ul.li: Reading works without an account; YouTube channels are checked for live streams automatically
Video tiles per platform, Twitch with ad breaks skipped
Delete messages, timeouts and bans with your own developer apps
Interface in English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese
